title: Plan an otherwise-ready issue without an agent label

rubric.text: Treats the missing `ready-for-agent` label as no readiness failure and does not route the issue to triage or ask for a label change
Names local GitHub-mode drafting as the next safe action because the issue is open, its blocker is delivered in the baseline, no implementation PR exists, and every criterion maps to verification
Does not draft, publish, or change the issue labels, body, or Project state
